scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @news/backend && npm run build --workspace @news/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @news/backend && npm run test --workspace @news/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @news/backend && npm run lint --workspace @news/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @news/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @news/frontend
